description:
Outbound is broken. Again.

But Jason Bay has the fix—and it’s not what you think.

This week on Unf*ck My Startup, we’re bringing back Jason Bay (Founder @ Outbound Squad) to drop a completely new outbound strategy that’s quietly generating ridiculous results in 2025.

No AI gimmicks
No high-volume spam
Just real pipeline from buyers who actually want to talk

Jason’s sharing:

His new 3-message outbound framework

What’s working right now for teams at $0–$5M ARR

When to add cold calls (and when to stop wasting your time)

Why "personalization at scale" is dead—and what to do instead

This is NOT the same playbook he dropped in August.
This is the upgrade. The evolution. The next wave.

📍 Watch the last episode here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c5DvcHlt1c8
🗓 LIVE: Tuesday, June 10 @ 3pm ET / Noon PT

Tag your head of sales. Tag your founder. Tag your SDRs.

This is how outbound actually works in 2025.
